title: A token-bucket rate limiter
prompt:
Implement `TokenBucket` in src/lib.rs for our API gateway: `TokenBucket::new(capacity, refill_per_sec)` starts full;
`allow(now_ms)` takes one token and returns true, or returns false when there is none. Tokens refill continuously at
`refill_per_sec` (fractions accumulate) up to `capacity`. `now_ms` never goes backwards; a call with the same time
refills nothing.
